name: Xixianykus
sum: Small, long-legged alvarezsaurid from the Coniacian–Santonian Majiacun Formation of Henan, China.
holotype: XMDFEC V0011, a partial skeleton without skull on a slab, Majiacun Formation, Xixia Basin, Henan, China.
biology: A short femur with long tibia and an arctometatarsalian foot point to a highly cursorial animal.
author: Xu et al. 2010

sources.text: X. Xu, D.-Y. Wang, and C. Sullivan, D. W. E. Hone, F.-L. Han, R.-H. Yan, F.-M. Du. 2010. A basal parvicursorine (Theropoda: Alvarezsauridae) from the Upper Cretaceous of China. Zootaxa 2413:1-19
